blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The father of the 16-year-old student involved in the deadly shooting at Banga National High School last month is facing criminal complaints after police found that his son had used a gun that was allegedly not properly secured at home. Maj. Robert D. Fores, officer-in-charge of the Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12)
